title: xyris arenicola
intro: Xyris arenicola, commonly known as sand-time grass, is a type of plant species that belongs to the family Xyridaceae. It has been used for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, helping to protect against cell damage and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Xyris arenicola include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Xyris arenicola include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
